page: Elysia configuration options for customizing server behavior. Constructor configuration object. prefix for route prefixes. normalize for field coercion. adapter for runtime adapters. allowUnsafeValidationDetails for validation error details. aot (Ahead of Time) compilation. detail for OpenAPI schema. encodeSchema for custom transforms. name for debugging and plugin deduplication. nativeStaticResponse for optimized responses. normalize modes: true, 'typebox', false. precompile for JIT compilation. sanitize function for string escaping. seed for plugin deduplication checksum. strictPath RFC 3986 compliance. serve configuration for HTTP server. tags for OpenAPI tags. systemRouter for Bun.serve.routes. websocket configuration. TLS with cert and key. maxRequestBodySize default 128MB. idleTimeout default 30 seconds. hostname default 0.0.0.0. port default 3000. Questions: How do I configure Elysia? What configuration options exist? How do I enable production features?

sections.manifest: Runtime adapter selection. BunAdapter for Bun runtime. Since 1.1.11. Default adapter based on environment. Adapter configuration. Questions: How do I configure the adapter? What adapters are available?

Unsafe validation details in production. allowUnsafeValidationDetails boolean option. Default false for security. Production validation error leakage prevention. Field names and types hidden on production. Public APIs may enable safely. Sensitive information protection. Since 1.4.13. Questions: Should I enable unsafe validation details? How does validation security work?

Ahead of Time (JIT) compilation. aot boolean option. Default false. Precompile routes before startup. Performance optimization at startup cost. Dynamic compilation on demand. Since 0.4.0. Questions: Should I enable AOT compilation? What's the performance trade-off?

OpenAPI schema for all routes. detail configuration object. hide option for hiding from documentation. tags array for route categorization. Route instance-wide OpenAPI configuration. Questions: How do I set OpenAPI details for all routes?

Custom transform encoding with Encode. encodeSchema boolean option. Default true. t.Transform custom encode functions. Encode before response to client. Custom encoding execution. Questions: How do I use custom encoding?

Instance naming for debugging. name string option. Plugin deduplication by name. 'service.thing' naming pattern. Singleton plugin registration. Questions: Why should I name instances? How does plugin deduplication work?

Native static response optimization. nativeStaticResponse boolean option. Since 1.1.11. Bun.serve.static optimization. Inline value handling. Runtime optimization for static responses. Questions: Should I enable native static response?

Field coercion and unknown property handling. normalize boolean or 'typebox' option. Default true. exact mirror coercion. TypeBox Value.Clean coercion. Unknown field error if false. Input/output field enforcement. Questions: How do I handle unknown fields? What's the normalize mode?

JIT precompilation before startup. precompile boolean option. Since 1.0.0. Default false. Dynamic route compilation. Startup time vs performance trade-off. Not recommended to enable. Questions: Should I use precompile? What's the startup performance impact?
URL path prefix for all routes. prefix string option. /v1 example. Route path prepending. /v1/name from /name route. Questions: How do I add a prefix to all routes?

String sanitization on validation. sanitize function or array of functions. Bun.escapeHTML() example. String value transformation on t.String(). Value reading and transformation. Questions: How do I sanitize strings? What's the sanitize function?

Plugin deduplication checksum seed. seed configuration object. seed.value for checksum generation. Plugin Deduplication mechanism. Any type: string, number, object. Questions: How does plugin deduplication work? Why use seed?

Strict path matching RFC 3986. strictPath boolean option. Default false. RFC 3986 path matching compliance. Suffix / tolerance when false. Exact path matching when true. /name vs /name/ equivalence. Questions: Should I use strict path matching? What's RFC 3986?

HTTP server configuration and behavior. serve object configuration. hostname default '0.0.0.0'. port default 3000. idleTimeout default 30 seconds. maxRequestBodySize default 1024*1024*128 (128MB). rejectUnauthorized from NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED. reusePort default true SO_REUSEPORT flag. unix socket support. server id for hot reload without interrupting requests. TLS configuration with cert and key. BoringSSL powered. Questions: How do I configure the HTTP server? How do I change the port? How do I enable TLS?

Detailed HTTP server configuration options. serve.hostname for listen address. serve.port for port binding. serve.idleTimeout in seconds for request completion deadline. serve.maxRequestBodySize in bytes for request limit. serve.reusePort SO_REUSEPORT for multiple process binding. serve.unix for unix socket instead of port+hostname. serve.tls for TLS/SSL configuration. serve.id for hot reload identification. serve.rejectUnauthorized for certificate validation. serve.requestCert for client certificate requests. serve.secureOptions for OpenSSL behavior. serve.serverName for explicit server name. TLS file paths with file() or Bun.file(). cert.pem and key.pem in PEM format. Questions: How do I use TLS? How do I increase timeout? What's SO_REUSEPORT?

OpenAPI tags for all routes. tags string array option. Route categorization in OpenAPI documentation. Default 'elysia' tag. OpenAPI schema generation. API documentation grouping. Questions: How do I add tags to all routes?

System router usage. systemRouter option for framework routing. Bun.serve.routes router on Bun runtime. Elysia's own router as fallback. Runtime optimization. Questions: Should I use system router? How does it optimize performance?

WebSocket configuration override. websocket configuration object. Bun WebSocket API extension. Automatic suitable configuration. perMessageDeflate for compression/decompression. Not recommended to change defaults. Questions: How do I configure WebSocket? What's perMessageDeflate?
